messages:
Maya (PM): New lightweight mock for Autoscaling & Capacity Controls: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/autoscale-lite. Core: Minimum capacity (GPUs), Maximum capacity (GPUs), Burst toggle (pool selector + duration), GPU pool search, Latency SLO (p95 ms) slider + numeric input, soft/hard guardrails, cost preview. Quick FYI before design review tomorrow.
Alex (Design): Nice simplification. Move SLO above guardrails. Labeling: 'Minimum capacity (GPUs)' and 'Maximum capacity (GPUs)'. For burst, show small billing hint: 'Burst billed hourly'. Use icon + text for soft vs hard guardrails.
Priya (Frontend): A11y checklist: slider needs aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow, keyboard support (arrow +/-1, shift+arrow +/-10), numeric input for precise entry, focus ring visible. Don't rely on color only for warnings.
Diego (Infra): Operational note: implement burst as logical pool mapping to a separate node group to avoid noisy neighbors. API snippet idea (high-level): capacity.min_gpus, capacity.max_gpus, burst.{enabled,pool_id,cap,duration_mins}, slo.{metric,target}, guardrails[]. Hard = block requests; soft = emit warning + annotate.
Sam (Eng Manager): Telemetry: events for edits (autoscale.update), cost preview (autoscale.preview_cost), guardrail_warning, guardrail_block. Rollout: FF -> internal 5% -> customers 25% -> 100. Add versioning for presets.
Jordan (UXR): Usability: users confuse 'instances' vs 'GPUs' in tests. Use explicit units and quick examples (e.g., '2 GPUs ≈ baseline throughput'). Also test if burst requires an explicit confirmation modal due to billing.
autoscale-bot: feature-flag "autoscale-controls-lite" enabled -> staging:true.
Maya (PM): Action items: @Alex update copy + move SLO; @Priya prototype slider + numeric input + keyboard flows; @Diego open API MR for burst pool lifecycle; @Sam draft telemetry schema. Review tomorrow 10:00. :calendar:
